quests.title: Short Delivery, Oatley
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. The Oatley order has been two cartons light every week since every second Friday and the invoice says otherwise every time. I have rung the number on the letter four times. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Oatley
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $128 owing to Oatley and it is not going to walk in here itself. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: $128, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Oatley Run
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. I do the Oatley run at knock-off and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Mortdale
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Oatley
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I have got a esky of warm cans in the back of the van and the Oatley shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Oatley
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Three of the Oatley regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $36 down on those days. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$36, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Oatley
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Everything Oatley sells comes off a floor at Mortdale, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. This is the third time I have had this conversation. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us
